race.comment: Keen to stick with TOO DARN DISCREET (5) out of the G3 Tesio Stakes here. She carried 60kg there but was still very well backed, holding her ground midfield and pulling up with an issue. She meets the winner 7kg better off now and gets Mark Zahra on from an ideal gate. VIVY AIR (8) comes down from Sydney in good form albeit needing another win. Third to Unleeshing two back in the G3 Angst is solid form before a luckless 5th behind Lindermann. Barrier one for a horse that can find trouble isn't ideal but she can win. SOVERATO (4) won the Tesio Stakes with 54kg, given a nice ride off a slow speed there. As mentioned, she meets TOO DARN DISCREET much worse but she'll get every chance again. JENNI'S MEADOW (10) was a narrow fifth in the Tesio too and will be running on. PANOVA (1) hasn't fired this time in but just wants a bit of tempo and J-Mac on now suits.
